name: agent-harness
description: A project harness that lets a product owner hand work to coding agents without reading the diff.

scripts.build:code: npm run workstation:check && npm run code:syntax && npm run code:console-routing
scripts.build:docs: npm run fsm:lint && npm run fsm:prefixes && npm run fsm:doc && npm run docs:index
scripts.build: npm run build:code && npm run build:docs
scripts.verify: npm run build && npm test && git diff --exit-code
